_doc: Your own views. Each entry: match (slug | slug glob | slug:Outcome | token id | condition id | 'q:question text'), and any of: p + sd (your probability and prob-sd confidence), shift (bias in prob points added after fusion), lo/hi (hard bounds), ts (when formed: the view fades with age), expires, note. Views without ':Outcome' are about the first outcome (YES) and are mirrored automatically for NO. Edit by hand or: py -m FairMV view <match> --p 0.6 --sd 0.04 --expires 48h. Entries with "disabled": true are ignored; _examples is ignored.
